query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_molecules,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(radar_intensity, '-', radar_freshness, '-', radar_warmth, '-', radar_sweetness, '-', radar_spiciness, '-', radar_earthiness)) as unique_profiles
FROM molecules;
